The present studies were designed to further characterize interactions between KOR systems and stress-induced behavior using footshock as a stressor; the effects of which can be measured by potentiation of the acoustic startle reflex. To characterize the involvement of this specific population of KORs we generated a conditional knockout in which KORs are selectively deleted in DA-containing neurons.
